remote_benchmark_package.note: Only unrelated command_view/turret_view are frozen; benchmark uses current gameplay/native source. Published server configuration/runtime files untouched.

limitations: Two reference and two native runs per workload; clocks and VM scheduling are uncontrolled. Percentiles are averaged per run, not pooled.
Stonehenge 32-bot native runs fired 52 shots vs 76 in references. Integrated trajectories diverge; matched-state differential tests establish kernel parity separately.
Authority timings exclude separate engine physics and transport/client work. Bot-heavy tests are not human-client capacity measurements.
All short authority matches ended 0-0; earlier long-run ST capture reliability remains unresolved.
Sustained projectile tests use empty parallel lanes, replenished ammunition and no mines. Mine behavior is tested separately.
32-avatar p95 did not improve. Desktop and synthetic XR policy tests do not establish headset performance.
Windows and Android builds were compiled but not measured on devices.
Remote package freezes unrelated command/turret UI scripts at base_revision; final current-source dedicated package smoke is separate.
Existing benchmark shutdown resource/ObjectDB warnings are distinct from test failures.
Both original remote game servers were terminated with explicit authorization and remain stopped.
excluded_attempts: Preliminary local avatar run overlapping package upload
Initial production smoke config missing set directives; corrected and rerun successfully
